title: A Signal for the Orbit
author: Mara Lockridge
blurb: Ulyana Reyes, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
